frequency_question: How often are incremental reserve ratio measures announced within a specific short calendar window by major emerging market central banks?
membership_rule: Members are central bank policy announcements introducing temporary or incremental reserve ratio requirements on commercial banks during periods of system liquidity surplus. Excluded are standard, scheduled base reserve ratio changes.

cases.name: RBI Additional CRR episodes historical equivalents
RBI liquidity management measure windows (various quarters)

provenance_note: claims 24 cases from only 3 named (8.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 3 representative cases detailed from structured central bank action logs; estimated 24 comparable liquidity tightening episodes globally in the past decade.
known_gaps: Varying definitions of secondary reserve requirements across different jurisdictions introduce minor noise.
skeleton: Central bank policy review cycles in emerging markets over the last two decades, multiplied by the fraction of those cycles involving targeted secondary reserve ratio tools.
multiplier: 24 major policy cycles observed; 2 instances of incremental reserve ratio deployment within a comparable 42-day window.
validity_reason: Central bank operating frameworks and liquidity management toolkits evolve slowly over multi-year horizons.
